groups.description: Checksums the same random byte buffer with CRC-32, CRC-32C, CRC-64/ECMA-182 and Adler-32 to compare non-cryptographic throughput at each payload size.

parameters.name: DataSize

groups.name: HasherSurfaceBenchmarks
groups.description: Measures the overhead of the injectable HashingService facade against the static Hasher hot path for the same SHA-256 digest.

parameters.name: DataSize
parameters.description: Size of the random input buffer being hashed (1 KB, 1 MB).

measurements.description: SHA-256 via the static Hasher.ComputeSha256 hot path (baseline).
measurements.slaStandard: SHA-256 on hardware-accelerated CPUs should sustain >= 200 MB/s; the service facade must not materially erode that throughput.

measurements.description: SHA-256 via the injectable IHashingService facade (measures abstraction overhead).
measurements.slaStandard: SHA-256 on hardware-accelerated CPUs should sustain >= 200 MB/s; the service facade must not materially erode that throughput.

measurements.description: SHA-256 via the static Hasher.ComputeSha256 hot path (baseline).
measurements.slaStandard: SHA-256 on hardware-accelerated CPUs should sustain >= 200 MB/s; the service facade must not materially erode that throughput.

measurements.description: SHA-256 via the injectable IHashingService facade (measures abstraction overhead).
measurements.slaStandard: SHA-256 on hardware-accelerated CPUs should sustain >= 200 MB/s; the service facade must not materially erode that throughput.

groups.name: HashingStreamBenchmarks
groups.description: Compares one-shot buffer hashing against incremental stream hashing (81920-byte reads) of the same random payload.

parameters.name: DataSize
parameters.description: Size of the random input buffer being hashed (1 MB, 10 MB).

measurements.description: One-shot SHA-256 over the full in-memory buffer (baseline).
measurements.slaStandard: Both one-shot and incremental SHA-256 should sustain >= 150 MB/s; streaming must not collapse throughput versus the one-shot path.

measurements.description: Incremental SHA-256 reading the payload through a hashing stream in 80 KB chunks.

groups.name: HexEncodingBenchmarks
groups.description: Hex encode (lowercase) and decode of digest-sized random buffers; isolates the encoding cost from the hash itself.

parameters.name: DigestSize

measurements.description: Encode a digest buffer to a lowercase hex string (baseline).

name: hashing
title: Hashing
description: SHA-2/MD5 content digests, non-cryptographic checksums (CRC-32/CRC-32C/CRC-64/Adler-32), HMAC keyed hashes, incremental stream hashing, the static-vs-injectable hashing surface, and hex encode/decode for Lyo.Hashing. Every payload is a buffer of cryptographically random bytes of the given DataSize, so timings reflect raw per-byte throughput (random data is incompressible and cannot be short-circuited).
